summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) of CipherBox using the GSD workflow — covering research, planning, wave-based execution, verification, security audit, and PR creation with full quality gates.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans/2 waves), executed, verified (7/7 must-haves, 89/89 SDK E2E), and PR #544 was opened. CI lint is failing at session end due to the new generator script being `.mjs` instead of `.ts`, which also bypassed pre-commit hooks — a fix agent was spawned but not yet completed.

repo: Scripts in `scripts/` must be `.ts` run via `tsx` (convention: `generate-test-vectors.ts`, `backfill-pinned-cids.ts`); `tsconfig.scripts.json` provides typechecking for that directory.
lint-staged globs cover `*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}` but NOT `mjs`/`mts` — a `.mjs` file silently bypasses all pre-commit linting, letting errors through to CI.
eslint `files` glob covers `{js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx}` but NOT `mts`/`cts` — both lint-staged and eslint config need extending.
`check-vector-parity.sh` is a meta-check only (validates hardcoded vector file list exists); it does NOT run the generator and does not yet include `tests/vectors/ipns/verify.json`.

SDK E2E `SDK_E2E_SECRET` must match `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` in `apps/api/.env` (`e2e-test-secret-ci-only`); vitest does NOT auto-load `tests/sdk-e2e/.env`, so a mismatch causes silent 401→suite-skip misread as 'infra-limited'.
`crates/fuse` cannot dev-depend on `api-client`/`core` (dependency cycle); cross-language test vectors belong in `crates/fuse/tests/`, not `crates/crypto/tests/`.
The commit helper can report `commit_failed` while the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never blindly retry.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — patch body via `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`.
Parallel worktree execution is unsafe for multi-crate crypto phases sharing `target/`/`node_modules`; sequential execution on the feature branch is the correct mode.
`git filter-branch --msg-filter` is the commit-reword tool here (`git rebase -i` is unavailable in this environment).
Desktop IPNS resolve sites (`apps/desktop/src-tauri/prepopulate.rs`, `vault.rs`) still use unverified `resolve_ipns` — explicitly out of scope for Phase 58 baseline.

code.finding: Unused `createIpnsRecord` variable — eslint error caught only by CI (pre-commit hook skips .mjs files).
Two prettier violations not caught locally due to .mjs extension being excluded from lint-staged.
`btoa(String.fromCharCode(...cbor))` pattern — CodeRabbit flagged as potentially corrupting bytes >127; replaced with `Buffer.from(cbor).toString('base64')` for clarity.
Missing unit tests for u64-overflow sequence rejection and invalid-UTF-8 CBOR Value rejection — genuine coverage gaps added post-CodeRabbit-CLI.
Missing explicit existence check on `cborFields['Sequence']` before BigInt coercion — added defensive guard with binding-mismatch error per CodeRabbit-CLI finding.
Sequence increment used unchecked `seq + 1`; replaced with `checked_add` per crate convention to prevent u64 overflow silently wrapping.

workflow: When an executor crashes mid-plan (socket close), assess git state first — committed tasks are safe, uncommitted diffs may still be on disk; a targeted continuation agent is cheaper than a full re-run.

CodeRabbit CLI (`coderabbit review --agent --base main --type committed`) catches issues before PR open; the PR-level re-review then re-examines fix commits and may raise new findings — both passes must be triaged.

Commit reword (to strip parentheses for commitlint) must happen after all doc commits land but before the first push — rewording after push requires a force-push that can race the release-bot's `chore(release)` commit.
A security-audit agent that writes to repo-root `SECURITY.md` must be corrected to write the phase-scoped doc instead; always verify the destination path.

Running the SDK E2E gate requires rebuilding the full client chain (`crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk→api`) from source before starting the API from dist — skipping the rebuild risks testing stale code.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task due to API socket close after committing 3 of 5 tasks — required manual state assessment and a targeted continuation agent.
SDK E2E was misclassified as 'infra-limited' by the executor due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch; the real suite had to be run manually with the correct secret.
One executor spawned for 58-02 silently also executed 58-03 in the same run — unplanned scope bleed that happened to be harmless but was hard to detect until checking git log.
The `commit_failed` false-negative from the commit helper required git log verification at multiple points throughout the session.
`gh pr edit` is broken for this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL error) — required a workaround via raw `gh api -X PATCH`.
CI lint failure from `.mjs` script discovered only after PR creation — the pre-commit hook gap (extension not in lint-staged) is what allowed the errors to reach CI.
`git push`/`git fetch` are blocked in sandbox and require disabling the sandbox for every push operation.
